Ae kapre mein lipatne wale
Atho aur logon ko khabardar karo.
Aur apne Parwardigar ki takbeer kaho.
Aur apne kapron ko pak rakho
Aur gandagi se kinara karlo.
Aur koi ehsan us niyat se na karo ke ziyada wasool krsko.
Aur apne Parwardigar ki khatir sabar se kaam lo.
Phir jab soor mein phonk maar di jaye gi.
To woh bara mushkil din hoga.
Aur kafiron ke liye woh aasan nahin hoga.
Us shaks ka mamla mujh par chhor do jise mein ne akela paida kiya.
Aur us ko maal diya jo door tak pehla para hai.
Aur bete diye jo samne maujood rehte hain.
Aur us ke liye har kaam ke raaste humwaar krdie.
Phir bhi woh yeh lalach karta hai ke mein use aur ziyada doon.
Hargiz nahin ! Woh hamari aayaton ka dushman bann gaya hai.
Anqareeb mein use ek kathin charhai par charhaon ga.
Us ka haal to yeh hai ke us ne soch kar ek baat banaee.
Khuda ki maar ho us par ke kaisi baat banaee.
Dobara khuda ki maar ho us par ke kaisi baat banaee.
Phir us ne nazar doraii.
Phir teweri charhai, aur moonh banaya.
Phir peechhe ko mra, aur guroor dkhaia.
Phir kehne laga ke : kuchh nahin, yeh to ek roaiti jadoo hai.
Kuchh nahin yeh to ek insan ka kalaam hai.
Anqareeb mein us shaks ko dozakh mein jhonk doon ga.
Aur tumhein kya pata ke dozakh kya cheez hai ?
Woh na kisi ko baqi rkhe gi, aur na chhore gi.
Woh khaalon ko jhulas dene wali cheez hai.
Us par unis (kaarinde) muqarrar hon ge.

Aur hum ne dozakh ke yeh kaarinde koi aur nahin, farishte muqarrar kiye hain. Aur un ki jo tadaad muqarrar ki hai woh sirf us liye ke us ke zariye kafiron ki aazmaish ho, taake ehle kitab ko yaqeen aajaye aur jo log iman lachke hain un ke iman mein aur azafa ho, aur ehle kitab aur momin log kisi shakk mein na paren, aur taake woh log jin ke dilon mein rog hai aur jo log kafir hain, woh yeh kahin ke bhala us ajeeb si baat se Allah ki kya murad hai ? Usi tarah Allah jis ko chahta hai gumraah kardyta hai aur jis ko chahta hai hidayat deta hai, aur tumhare Parwardigar ke lashkaron ko us ke siwa koi nahin jaanta. Aur yeh saari baat to naw bashar ke liye ek yaad dihani karane wali naseehat hai aur bas.
Khabardar ! Qasam hai chand.
Aur raat ki jab woh moonh phir kar jane lage.
Aur subah ki jab us ka ajala phil jaye.
Ke yeh bari bari baaton mein se ek hai.
Jo tamam insano ko khabardar kar rahi hai.
Tum mein se har us shaks ko jo aage barhna ya peechhe htna chahaye.
Har shaks apne kartoot ki wajah se girwi rakhha hua hai.
Siwaye dayen haath walon ke
Ke woh jannaton mein hon ge. Woh pochh rahe hon ge.
Mujreemon ke bare mein.
Ke : tumhein kis cheez ne dozakh mein dakhil kardiya ?
Woh kahin ge ke : hum namaz parhne walon mein se nahin the.
Aur hum miskeen ko khana nahin khilate the.
Aur jo log behoda baaton mein ghuste, hum bhi un ke saath gahasa jaya karte the.
Aur hum roz jza ko jhoot qarar dete the.
Yahan tak ke woh yaqeeni baat humare paas hi gayi.
Chunanche sifarish karne walon ki sifarish aise logon ke kaam nahin aaye gi.
Ab un logon ko kya hogaya hai ke yeh naseehat ki baat se moonh more hue hain ?
Us tarah jaise woh jungli gadhe hon.
Jo kisi sher se (darr kar) bhaag pare hon.
Bulke un mein se har shaks yeh chahta hai ke use khle hue saheefe pakra diye jayen.
Hargiz nahin ! Baat asal mein yeh hai ke un ko aakhirat ka khof nahin hai.
Hargiz nahin ! Yeh (quran hi) ek naseehat hai.
Ab jo chahaye, us se naseehat hasil karle.
Aur yeh log naseehat hasil karen ge nahin, illa yeh ke Allah hi aisa chahaye. Wahi us baat ka ehle hai ke us se dara jaye aur wahi us ka ehle hai ke logon ki magfirat kare.
